note: rc6: local anchors measured on the papers' own figures (publisher rasters), for tests/test_figure_anchors.py, at each panel's scale bar read with its anti-aliased ends (provenance/rc6_traces/README.md; rc5 read the bars at their full-intensity length, 46 px for Dinh's 50 um and 107 px for Gifford's 300 um, 2.0 % and 0.5 % short).  Measurements: provenance/rc6_scripts/rc6_measurements.json (measure_rc6.py) and provenance/rc6_traces/results/.  Gifford Fig. 6's micrograph: provenance/rc6_scripts/gifford_fig6_measurement.json, read directly by the test.  Global schematic panels carry no scale (not_to_scale).  The rc5 values are kept under rc5_values.

dinh2024_fig2b_panel4.source: Dinh et al. 2024 Lab Chip 24, 913-923, Fig. 2B fourth panel (printed p. 917); PDF page 5 raster 982 x 1940 px

flare_deg_per_side.basis: from each wall's own straight direction (the two straight walls are tilted 0.35 and 0.70 deg in the raster); 24 fit intervals per wall; measure_dinh_flare.py v2 (the right wall's rows beside the caption's '52 um' label excluded); angles are scale-free, unchanged in rc6

flare_onset_from_last_gap_centre_um.basis: rc5 measure_dinh_flare.py onset rows (px) converted at the corrected bar

post_pitch_um.basis: pill centres along two post columns on each of panels 2-4 (six readings); tolerance: the bar read to +-0.3 % plus the readings' spread

dinh2024_fig2b_panel4.scale_bar_basis: the bar read with its anti-aliased ends (bar_length_aa; all four panels 46.906 px; rc5 46 px)

gifford2014_fig4_inset.source: Gifford et al. 2014 Lab Chip 14, 4496-4505, Fig. 4 inset (legs 2 and 4 in operation; printed p. 4500); 300 um bar
gifford2014_fig4_inset.l_g_basis: l_g by the centre-to-centre separation of each leg's two post columns minus the printed 100 um centre: free of the outline bias and of the relief contrast's along-flow shift
gifford2014_fig4_inset.widths_basis: leg 4 widths on the registered trace (provenance/rc6_traces/results/gifford/gifford_results_design.json, measured.leg4_widths_um); uncertainty 2 px

not_to_scale.gifford2014_fig4_left: Gifford p. 4502: '(Fig. 4 and 6 are not drawn to scale, for clarity)': topology only
not_to_scale.gifford2014_fig6: the same sentence: the schematic (left panel), topology only.  The micrograph (right panel) is measured at its printed centre width: provenance/rc6_scripts/gifford_fig6_measurement.json
not_to_scale.dinh2024_fig2a_main: the arm span read as the 3.2 mm chip width gives a 60.6 mm drawing against the printed 75.8 mm (r4/dinh_layout_meas.json): the panel's global scale is not established; values read at it (port radii) carry that uncertainty
not_to_scale.dinh2024_fig2a_inset: magnified (caption); its own scale from the 3.2 mm chip, cross-checked by the 2(GS + wall) unit pitch

post_pitch_um.basis: pill outline centres, two post columns; the bar's +-1 px is 2 %
